Identity/distinctiveness neighborhood. Individuality is broader than unique, so Narrowed fails; same territory, different organizing frame (product distinctiveness → selfhood). Reframed is correct.

Customization is an operationalization of creative capacity, not a strict subtype. Frame shifts from general creative production to consumer-facing personalization. Reframed is correct; Narrowed would over-correct.

Test: 'Nostalgia is a specific way of being narration/narrative' — TRUE. Nostalgia is a specific emotional register of storytelling (sentiment-driven memory narrative is a subtype of narration). POST is a proper subset of PRE. Narrowed is correct; PRE is substantive but nostalgia is still a recognizable narrative subtype.

Quality is broader than luxury (luxury is a specific kind of quality positioning), so Narrowed fails. Same premium-standards territory with shifted frame (luxury positioning → underlying quality standards). Reframed is correct.

Accessibility (inclusivity/ease of access) is in a genuinely different conceptual domain from all PRE descriptors (environmental, luxury, creative, distinctiveness, narrative). No transformation defensible; no neighborhood. New stands.
